fields.Name: T224 - Grid Multi-Column Sort
fields.Description: Uses a grid's Sorting panel to sort by a column and verifies the row order changes and a sort indicator is shown.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Products' entity grid — type 'Products' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click it (or navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Products). Wait for the grid to load. In the grid toolbar (controls above the grid, mostly upper-right): click the 'Sorting' control (up-wide-short icon) to open the sort panel — OR click a column header directly. Apply a sort on a column (e.g. Name ascending). Verify the grid re-orders its rows accordingly and a sort indicator is shown on the sorted column. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A sort was applied to a grid column (via the Sorting panel or a column header)
The grid re-ordered its rows and shows a sort indicator on the sorted column
No error messages or crash pages
